AiTestingDefinition.description: Category 1d: Dress Code & Policies (Data 360 Knowledge RAG - Policies)
AiTestingDefinition.name: Ambika_FAQ_tests_1d_Policies

inputs.utterance: What is the dress code at Post Oak Smokehouse in Austin?

scorer.name: bot_response_rating
scorer.expectedValue: Post Oak Smokehouse has a relaxed, casual dress code where jeans, boots, shorts, and t-shirts are welcome in both the dining room and outdoor beer garden (shirts and shoes required).

inputs.utterance: Are kids and dogs allowed at Post Oak Smokehouse in Austin?

scorer.name: bot_response_rating
scorer.expectedValue: Children of all ages are welcome at Post Oak Smokehouse with high chairs, booster seats, and a kids BBQ slider plate available. Leashed, well-behaved dogs are welcome on the outdoor beer garden patio, while only ADA service animals are permitted indoors.

inputs.utterance: Does Post Oak Smokehouse in Austin have a private dining table for 8 people, and what is their cancellation policy?

scorer.name: bot_response_rating
scorer.expectedValue: Groups of 8 to 10 guests at Post Oak Smokehouse can request the semi-private Pitmaster Table at no extra room fee, and reservations can be modified or cancelled at no charge up until the reservation time.
